_note: STAGE A. Purpose is to LOCATE the regime boundary, not to resolve it.
Resolution is deliberately coarse: 0.25 kPa x 0.5 K over the whole box
is 27 x 25 = 675 points at 3 s, roughly 80 core-hours. qs_refine_points
then bisects only the cells where the label actually changes.
The box is centred on the case nominal and spans well past +/-3 sigma of
both measurement errors, so the answer to 'which regime is the experiment
in, and how far is the boundary in units of measurement error' is inside
the sweep rather than extrapolated from its edge.
For case 3 (SBLI) the p_c range must be shifted up to bracket 68.9 kPa --
copy this file to sweep_coarse_c3_v1.json and change the two pc segments.
